description: This source file defines the Login React component responsible for user authentication, including email/password login and Google Sign-In integration using Google Identity Services. It handles form state, invokes authentication APIs, initializes Google Sign-In, and manages redirection post-login.

methods.name: Login()
methods.description: React functional component implementing the login page UI and logic.

methods.name: handleGoogleCredential
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving Google credential, handles authentication exchange, token storage, and redirection.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Initializes Google Identity Services and sets up Google Sign-In button and One Tap prompt on component mount.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for email/password login, invoking signIn from context, and redirects upon success.
